_contract: The maintainer decision A3 runs under. AUTHORIZES SPEND; authorizes no launch by itself -- a launch still needs the one-use authorization issued FROM this grant, a launch-bound readiness record and a staged bundle. Every scientific and harness identity is DERIVED by issue_a3_authorization.py and REFUSED if asserted here.
granted_by: Maintainer decision 2026-10-01, on independent review of review/c3-operator-batching@a87049cc, which established that no maintainer or scientific decision blocks execution. A3 is authorized as ONE complete end-to-end experiment -- initialization, recovery training, evaluation, aggregation, closeout -- rather than as a step-1/step-2 split needing intermediate approvals. Ordinary engineering failures inside this envelope are to be diagnosed, repaired and retried autonomously.
granted_for: A3, the complete one-arm x three-seed chain
covers: ONE A3 session: replay the frozen pre-ATTENTION parent under its digest gate, verify A-bsz1 rebuilds the frozen incumbent, collect interleaved A-bsz1/A-bsz3 diagnostics, train THREE A-bsz3 recovery probes at the three frozen C3 seeds, evaluate each ONCE on c1_confirmation_v1 after the protocol admission, preserve and package, collect evidence and tear down. The comparison runs OFF POD at $0 afterwards.
a_differing_digest_is_a_finding: A-bsz3's artifact digest is pinned nowhere and is what the experiment measures. A difference from A-bsz1 is recorded and the chain continues; only the integrity stops in the frozen design end it.
_hard_cap_is_derived_not_chosen: $8.2525 is the ceiling a3_pricing.py DERIVES from the live L40S securePrice over the measured component table. The issuer re-derives it and refuses this grant if the two disagree, so this field is a statement of agreement rather than a request.
_budget_position_at_grant: formal remaining $9.7031 of $65.6523, package remaining $11.6426 of $75.6523, project $383.3623 of $400.0000. The 2026-10-01 amendment funds the derived ceiling plus ONE pre-science restart of $1.4506 and nothing more; the historical $0.9492 formal overspend stands as fact.
autonomous_pre_science_retry: PERMITTED inside this cumulative envelope. An invocation that aborts before formal training begins produced no measurement to retry: preserve and close that attempt, diagnose, repair minimally, build a FRESH chain under a new attempt identity and continue. The budget is cumulative across every subrun; a rerun does not reset it.
